/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='kk-save-review-'))
plugin = pathlib.Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-opus55-581dd0e1-20261011/kk/0.23.0')
base = subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], text=True).strip()
paths = ['README.md','service.py','client.py','store.py','tests/test_save.py']
provenance = []
for kind, ref in [('candidate', ':'), ('historical', base+':')]:
    for name in paths:
        data = subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ref+name])
        target = root/kind/name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(data)
        target.chmod(0o444)
        provenance.append({'repository':str(repo),'revision': 'index' if kind=='candidate' else base,'original_path':name,'artifact':str(target),'git_blob':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',ref+name],text=True).strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'line_span':[1,len(data.splitlines())],'omitted_redacted':'none'})
fd, diffpath = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='selected-', suffix='.patch',dir=root)
with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:
    f.write(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--binary','--','service.py']))
pathlib.Path(diffpath).chmod(0o444)
criteria = [str(plugin/'skills/review-code'/name) for name in ['functional-review.md','shared-change-context.md','shared-review-scope-protocol.md','shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']] + [str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/name) for name in ['security-checklist.md','solid-checklist.md','code-quality-checklist.md','removal-plan.md']]
assert len(criteria)==8 and all(pathlib.Path(p).is_file() for p in criteria)
(root/'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+'\\n')
context = '''Intent and authority: README.md is the explicit save contract. A serialized save is identified by caller operation ID. Failed saves may be retried with the same ID and edited values; success activates the latest submitted values. Completed-ID repeats return its receipt. Fresh IDs must perform fresh saves, including in the same workspace. Recovery records are retained for audit. Provider replacement is idempotent. Receipt writing can fail after application. No concurrency, restart, network service or exactly-once external effect is promised.
Change boundary: user requested review of the staged save recovery update. Selector git diff --cached; service.py only, 8 additions and 8 deletions. Candidate staged service blob 0435141ceb7f934d59e6628b3720dea7f25f747f; worktree equals index. The purpose of the update is inferred as improving save recovery while preserving README contracts. No author rationale or test execution claims provided.
Baselines: review base HEAD feeb199add2b6ae7b800a45b7b6856ab45ad2a67; full base sources included. No separate release/deployment baseline is named or requested. Local git has no tags. Assess the in-memory contract against base and candidate, not production deployment.
Affected behavior: client.submit delegates to service.save; Store.apply replaces preferences; Store.receipt optionally fails once before completing the recovery record. Follow initial success, receipt failure and intermediate state, retry with same and edited values, completed-ID repeat, and fresh-ID saves on the same workspace. Existing tests cover nominal save, same-value retry and nominal completed-ID repetition; no tests executed by parent at dispatch.
Task Scope: No task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc.
Knowledge: parent searches kk:review-findings (save recovery retry) and kk:lang-idioms (Python exception persistence) returned an empty knowledge base.
Review availability: PAL tools/listmodels are unavailable; only this independent reviewer can run. Do not simulate external review or corroboration. No rejected approaches supplied.
'''
(root/'context.txt').write_text(context)
manifest = {'plugin_root':str(plugin),'instructions':criteria,'diff':diffpath,'candidate_source':[str(root/'candidate'/p) for p in paths],'historical_source':[str(root/'historical'/p) for p in paths],'provenance':str(root/'provenance.json'),'context':str(root/'context.txt'),'selector':'git diff --cached','active_profile':'python (.py extension)','no_matches':['go','java','js_ts','kotlin','k8s','k8s-operator','skill-md']}
(root/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
print(json.dumps({'bundle':str(root),'manifest':manifest,'criteria_ledger_reconciled':True},indent=2))
PY"
